item.title: Blues defeat Kraken 3-2 in final game before NHL trade deadline
item.description: SEATTLE (AP) — Dylan Holloway scored the go-ahead goal in the second period, Brayden Schenn had three assists and the St. Louis Blues beat the Seattle Kraken 3-2 on Wednesday night. Robert Thomas added a goal and an assist, and defenseman Logan Mailloux also scored as the last-place Blues improved to 9-17-3 on the road [...]

item.title: Woman identified in Carlyle, Ill., death investigation
item.description: The Major Case Squad has released the name of the woman found dead inside her Carlyle, Illinois, residence Tuesday morning.

item.title: Missouri mom shines on 'American Idol'
item.description: A mother of three from rural Missouri has advanced on American Idol after performing an original song inspired by the challenges of early motherhood and postpartum depression.

item.title: Maryville University announces NCAA Division I men’s hockey program
item.description: Maryville University announced Wednesday it will launch an NCAA Division I men’s hockey program.

item.title: Debate grows over St. Louis police pay, city budget
item.description: A heated debate took center stage at St. Louis Police Headquarters on Wednesday, as city leaders clashed over the future of policing in St. Louis.

item.title: Three years missing, father’s case now ‘criminal’
item.description: Wesley Moser Jr. reportedly walked away from a friend’s home on Goldman Road in Hillsboro on May 1, 2023. He left behind his phone and wallet. No one has seen him since.

item.title: Soldier killed in Iran conflict was Webster University student
item.description: One of six soldiers killed abroad over the weekend following the start of the U.S.-Israel bombing campaign against Iran had ties to the St. Louis area.

item.title: Family loses everything in home explosion; community rallies in support
item.description: The Missouri Division of Fire Safety is investigating the fire. A spokesperson said a subcontractor for AT&T was installing fiber-optic cable in the area and it is believed they hit a gas line.

item.title: Homicide suspect found dead in south St. Louis hotel
item.description: The subject of a homicide investigation was found shot to death Tuesday afternoon inside a room at a south St. Louis hotel.

item.title: Family discovers relative’s body, questions search efforts after deadly fire
item.description: A north St. Louis County family is seeking closure after they said a local fire department failed to find their love one’s remains, forcing them to do it themselves.
